units.title: Outbox queues idempotency
units.acceptanceCriteria: Complete outbox queues idempotency functionality, contract and authorization-negative tests, documentation, and recorded acceptance evidence.
verification: Versioned commands bind each tenant-scoped idempotency key to a canonical SHA-256 request digest; identical input replays the original response and different-input key reuse is rejected.
The transactional adapter atomically commits domain changes, the idempotency result and the outbound event; tests prove a rolled-back command publishes no event.
Leased delivery uses durable consumer/message deduplication, acknowledges only after successful transactional consumption, schedules bounded retries and dead-letters exhausted messages.

Authorization-negative and malformed-contract tests cover cross-tenant access, missing permissions, unavailable audit storage, unknown versions, malformed identifiers, stale leases and storage failure.
